name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-grassland-yoshi-s-island-style
title: Super Mario World - Grassland Yoshi's Island Style
description:
The famous Yoshi's island style Super Mario World by @eto2d into ACTUAL Super Mario World!

Includes what you expect: ExGFX, Palette, Level and Map16.

ExGFX80 - goes on BG2 (If you need, you can change the order in the Map16 page, of course)
ExGFX81 - goes on FG1 (Additional graphics; pipes, ! Blocks, and others)
Uses Palette 2 and 3

The tiles work with the graphic index's "Normal 1" but the additional ceiling tiles work only with the "underground 1" setting.

Main artist: @eto2d
Ripped by: XradicalD
